text:
maya: Heads up — Nexleap flagged an unexpected overage on their Dedicated invoice INV-2026-3119. They say burst usage doubled during an EU failover window on 2026-03-15.
ranjit: copying the billing export; looks like we received duplicate meter events from our third-party metering vendor (CloudMeter) between 03:12–03:28 UTC.
carla-finance: how big is the delta? need numbers to propose a provisional credit.
samir: quick CSV snippet from the raw meter feed:

```
timestamp,customer,region,meter_id,units
2026-03-15T03:12:04Z,Nexleap,eu-west,CM-DED-BURST,1420
2026-03-15T03:12:04Z,Nexleap,eu-west,CM-DED-BURST,1420
2026-03-15T03:15:09Z,Nexleap,eu-west,CM-DED-BURST,1298
```

samir: the duplicate line is the same event recorded twice; that sums to ~4.1k extra burst units.
carla-finance: OK rough math: our burst rate for Dedicated is $0.0039/unit — 4100 * 0.0039 = $15.99. But invoice shows $12,358.67 overage. that mismatch suggests other aggregated meter mappings also duplicated (KV-cache hits, prefix-cache units).
olivia: filing vendor ticket now (CM-32459). CloudMeter replied "ingesting duplicate events caused by retry loop" and are investigating root cause and ETA for fix.
maya: Nexleap is pushing for an immediate credit because this impacted their SLA budget. they included the invoice PDF and a spreadsheet with our per-route breakdown.
carla-finance: propose provisional goodwill credit of $12,358.67 while vendor investigation is pending? we need signoff from finance leads + ops to route as vendor recoverable.
ranjit: ops: can we confirm this is vendor-recoverable? if duplicates are from their ingest pipeline, we should recover, but timelines matter.
samir: ops confirms logs show identical event IDs, vendor-side retry loop. mark as vendor-responsible and create case for cost recovery.
carla-finance: ok, I need approval to issue provisional credit now to prevent churn. This will be tagged as "Vendor Recovery - Pending" and we'll chase CloudMeter for reimbursement. Anyone object? :eyes:
ranjit: +1 from ops. document the evidence and CC legal if it's >$10k.
olivia: legal looped in, they want the vendor ticket ID and the statement from CloudMeter admitting the duplicate ingestion.
maya: Nexleap asked for timeline — can we commit to an immediate reversal/credit on their account and a follow-up reconciliation? they said they're evaluating renewing next quarter.
carla-finance: approve provisional credit but want a 2-week clawback window if vendor does not reimburse. GL impact: use account 6102 (Deferred Credits - Vendor Recoverable).
samir: noted. I'll prepare the accounting memo and attach the raw event IDs and signed statement from CloudMeter once we have it.
carla-finance: accounting entry we'll use (provisional):

```
DR Revenue Adjustment 6102: $12,358.67
CR Accounts Receivable 1200: $12,358.67
```

carla-finance: would like @maya to confirm the customer-facing message. keep it factual and say "provisional credit issued pending vendor reimbursement".
maya: drafting message now:

"Hi team — we found duplicated meter events from our third-party metering vendor during your EU failover window (2026-03-15). We've issued a provisional credit of $12,358.67 to your account while we work with the vendor to recover the amount. We will follow up with a final reconciliation within 14 business days. Apologies for the disruption and thanks for flagging this."

maya: sending to Nexleap now. will paste permalink when sent.
carla-finance: please attach the invoice line detail and our reconciliation CSV. also mark the support case as high priority.
ranjit: ops will add a monitoring alert to detect duplicate event ID patterns to avoid repeat incidents.
olivia: CloudMeter responded: "we accept responsibility; root cause identified; remediation patch deployed. We will provide formal reimbursement request within 7 business days." (ticket CM-32459 update)
carla-finance: good. finance approvals: @carla-finance (self), @ranjit (ops), @samir (eng) — please react with :thumbsup: to record sign-off.
carla-finance: (reacts) :thumbsup:
ranjit: (reacts) :thumbsup:
samir: (reacts) :thumbsup:
maya: sent the message to Nexleap — https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C01EXAMPLE/p1769456789001234 (sent)
carla-finance: I'll post the provisional credit journal and mark the invoice as adjusted in the billing system. tagging it: VendorRecovery/CloudMeter/CM-32459.
olivia: will follow up daily with CloudMeter until reimbursement is received.
maya: Nexleap replied: "thanks — appreciate the quick action. please keep us posted on recovery." :+1:
carla-finance: closing loop here — provisional credit issued. follow-ups: CloudMeter reimbursement ETA, final reconciliation, GL reversal if vendor reimburses. leaving thread open until final settlement.
billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-3119 status updated -> ADJUSTED (credit $12,358.67) / Case: CM-32459
